purpose: 보고서·회의록·매뉴얼·업무 기록을 근거와 독자 목적에 맞게 제작하고 렌더링까지 검증한다.

preparation: identify audience, purpose, source facts, required format, template, confidentiality and approval
choose report, minutes, manual or work record
presentation and meeting artifacts only when requested or accepted
execution: report separates result, evidence, interpretation, risk and action
minutes separate decisions, owner, deadline, open questions and raw discussion
manual uses reproducible steps, prerequisites, warnings and rollback
work record stores current facts, evidence, limits and handoff rather than effort diary
verification: source facts and numbers trace to evidence
render and visual layout when artifact format requires it
avoid duplicate documents when canonical record already exists
completion: store final artifact and source/version metadata
report artifact path, approval state and remaining action
